Daily 10 Privacy Policy

Effective date: 29 October 2026
Android application: com.decadencearcade.daily10

This policy explains how Daily 10, an Android trivia app and home-screen widget, handles information. It describes the current app, in which quiz gameplay and history work locally, without a Daily 10 account or connected cloud service.

Information stored on your device

Daily 10 stores your quiz answers, unfinished selections, scores, completed quiz history, practice state, and app preferences on your device. Quiz records can include question details, quiz dates, answer and completion times, local play dates, time-zone information, and a randomly generated attempt identifier. This information supports gameplay, daily rollover, progress, streaks, insights, and saved reviews.

The current app does not send your quiz history to the developer or operate a developer-hosted database. It does not require your name, email address, or a Google sign-in to play.

Manual exports and Android backups

If you choose to export your history, Daily 10 writes a JSON backup to the location you select using Android's file picker. The file contains quiz history and related metadata. A location you choose may be provided by a cloud-storage service; that service handles the file under its own privacy practices. Daily 10 does not automatically upload these exports. Keep exported files private and share them only with people or services you trust.

Android's system backup and device-transfer features may also copy eligible quiz progress and history, depending on your device, backup provider, and settings. These features are separate from Daily 10's own cloud-backup feature, which is not connected in the current app.

Advertising, tracking, and device access

The current app contains no advertising or analytics SDK and does not send developer-operated analytics or crash reports. It does not request access to your location, contacts, camera, or microphone. The app uses your device's date and time to select the day's quiz.

Google Play and purchases

The app includes the Google Play Billing library, but checkout, purchase restoration, and purchase verification are disabled in the current version. The current purchase flow stops before connecting to Google Play Billing and cannot charge you. The developer does not receive your payment-card details.

Google Play and Android may independently process information when you use their services, such as installing or updating the app and using system backup. See Google's Privacy Policy. This policy will be updated before Daily 10 enables account services, cloud synchronization, or purchases that change its data handling.

Retention, deletion, and security

Local information remains on your device until you clear Daily 10's app storage through Android Settings or remove the app. Clearing app storage removes locally saved progress and preferences. Exported files and system backups are separate copies: delete exports from the locations where you saved them, and manage system backups through your device or backup provider. Restoring a backup can restore saved information.

Daily 10 uses Android's app-private storage for its local records. Device security and access to files you export depend on your device settings and chosen storage provider. No storage method can be guaranteed completely secure.

Account & data deletion

See Account & data deletion for deletion requests and instructions for removing locally saved progress.

Contact

For privacy questions or requests, contact the Daily 10 developer at farz@decadenceinc.com. If you contact us, we use the information you provide to answer your request and retain it only as needed to handle the enquiry and meet applicable obligations. Do not send passwords, payment details, or private quiz-backup files.

Changes to this policy

Updates will be published on this page with a revised effective date. Material changes to the app's data handling will be reflected here and communicated in the app where appropriate.
